featured_reviews.name: Rakesh Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a good experience at Suryavanshi Sabha Graha in Mumbai. It is a well-known place for hosting events like weddings, functions, meetings, and cultural programs. The hall is spacious and can accommodate a good number of people comfortably. The seating arrangement is decent and can be adjusted based on the event.
The place is clean and well-maintained. Basic facilities like lighting, fans, and stage setup are available and work properly. The staff is cooperative and tries to help during events, which makes the overall experience smoother. The location in Dadar is also convenient, as it is easy to reach by public transport.
Parking space can be a little limited during big events, so it is better to plan in advance. However, the overall management of the venue is good. The hall is suitable for both small and medium-sized functions. The atmosphere is simple but comfortable for guests.
Overall, Suryavanshi Sabha Graha is a reliable and budget-friendly option for organizing events in Mumbai. It offers decent facilities and a convenient location. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a simple and practical venue in Dadar.

Never expected a place with such a traditional name to be so posh. The moment you enter the premises, you are greeted by an extremely beautiful copper statue of Lord Ganesha.
As you climb up the stairs there are beautiful yellow and orange garlands adorning the stairway with beautiful bouquets on elegant stands. It looks that the place is always booked as you can see decorators either setting up a venue or taking it down. The hall is very spacious. It has a lift but it is down with maintenance. It does have a great open space downstairs which can be used for occasions. Mayur Caterers serve you delicious vegetarian and Jain dishes. The cleanliness aspect ratio is very high. The ceilings are very classy. There is a beautiful swing with a beautiful  green floral background. Amazing vibes can be felt there as it is close to the beach and that too in a centrally located place like Dadar.

featured_reviews.name: KRUPALI CHAVAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated our father’s 60th birthday at Vows Banquet, Prabhadevi and it was truly a blast!

A special mention to Prakash such a jolly and helpful person who took care of every detail and ensured the event was organised exactly as planned. Huge shoutout as well to the banquet team, Siddhesh & Ajay, for taking such great care of all our guests and making sure the starters and dinner were served smoothly. They were always just one call away whenever we needed any assistance.

The food was absolutely delicious and all our guests couldn’t stop complimenting it. Truly, just like the name our function was also “Just Wowww”!

Thank you once again to the entire team. Looking forward to celebrating many more functions with you guys!

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wedding & reception at Vows Banquet Hall... Food, hospitality, staff & services were awesome. They helped us providing their expertise to plan our event and made our event smooth by providing good services. Guests were very happy and everyone enjoyed the food as it was very delicious as we had experienced before. Thank you Mr. Prakash for your guidance, planning & hospitality.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: “Thank you so much for your valuable feedback! We’re glad you had a great experience with us. Looking forward to serving you again.”

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! 😊 We are delighted to know that you had a great experience with us. featured_reviews.name: anup mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
"We recently celebrated our daughter’s 5th birthday party, and we were thoroughly impressed with the arrangements from start to finish. The venue's ambience was warm and inviting, creating the perfect atmosphere for a celebration. The decorations were vibrant and well-coordinated, making the space feel magical for both children and adults.

The host was fantastic—leading the games with great enthusiasm and ensuring all the children were engaged and having fun. The addition of the tattoo station was a huge hit, adding an extra layer of excitement for the kids.

What truly stood out was the food. It was exceptional in both taste and presentation, exceeding our expectations. The variety offered catered to everyone, and many of our guests commented on how delicious everything was.

A special mention goes to Prakash, who was incredibly cooperative throughout the planning process. His prompt communication and attention to detail ensured that everything ran smoothly on the day. We couldn’t have asked for better hospitality. Thank you for making our daughter’s birthday such a memorable and hassle-free experience. We highly recommend your services for anyone planning an event!"

featured_reviews.name: Prateek Athalye
featured_reviews.review_text: Had my engagement ceremony hosted at the rooftop. The venue was perfect for a sundowner. Post 530 pm there is hardly any direct sunlight making the ambience look beautiful.  The venue also had decent light setup and fans to keep the place cool. The team (Vincent sir) is very humble and supportive.  He arranged very swiftly whatever our requirements and tantrums were. He also customized a high tea and snack counter and the food was of good quality. Would definitely recommend to speak to Vincent sir to get your event done here.

featured_reviews.name: Eureka Talashilkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The food was awesome — very tasty and delicious! All the arrangements were excellent and well-coordinated. Overall, we had a wonderful experience. The only area that could be improved is the decoration — the cost was a bit on the higher side, and the decorator could be a little more cooperative.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: “Thank you so much for your valuable feedback! We’re glad you had a great experience with us. Looking forward to serving you again.”

featured_reviews.name: Aditti S Pote
featured_reviews.review_text: I visit Vows Banquets every alternate week for our business networking meetings. It is a well-maintained and systematically managed banquet hall. It is spacious and the ambience is elegant. The food arrangements are good as well.

Beautiful and well-maintained hall with excellent arrangements and supportive staff. The ambiance and decoration were amazing, and everything was managed smoothly. featured_reviews.name: Hemakshi Tawade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our reception was held on 12th December 2025 at Kohinoor Hall (First Floor). If the first-floor hall is booked, the dining arrangements are on the ground floor, which is very convenient. For the second-floor hall, dining is arranged on the terrace both options are well managed.
Overall, our experience was excellent. The decoration, management, and arrangements were very well organized. A special thanks to Mr. Nitin, who patiently explained every detail to us, guided us throughout the process, and ensured that the billing and accounts were clearly and properly explained.The hall’s location right next to thenDadar railway station is a big advantage, making it extremely convenient for guests. All the facilities promised were provided exactly as per the charges, with no compromises.
Overall, we are very satisfied with the services and highly recommend Kohinoor Hall for any special occasion.
Thank you, Kohinoor Hall and Mr. Nitin, for making our day memorable.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: “My wedding at this marriage hall was truly a memorable experience. This was the second marriage function from our family at this venue, which itself shows our trust and satisfaction with their service. The hall looked beautiful and elegant, and everything was arranged perfectly from start to finish. Special thanks to Mr. Nitin Mane, who managed the hall and catering exceptionally well. His coordination, support, and attention to every detail made our special day completely stress-free. The food quality, decoration, cleanliness, and hospitality were excellent, and all our guests appreciated the arrangements. Thank you for making our wedding day so special and unforgettable. Highly recommended for weddings and family events!”

featured_reviews.name: Prachi Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted a wedding function at this beautiful wedding hall, and the entire experience was amazing. The venue was spacious, well-maintained, and perfectly organized for such a special occasion. The decoration, lighting, and overall atmosphere made the event even more memorable.
A special thanks to Nitin for his outstanding support and coordination throughout the function. He was extremely helpful, professional, and always available whenever we needed assistance. His attention to detail and friendly nature made everything smooth and stress-free for our family and guests.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a perfect venue for weddings and special events!

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh Metre
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted a wedding & receiption ceremony at this banquet hall and had a very pleasant experience. The hall is spacious, clean, and beautifully maintained with elegant interiors. The staff was polite, cooperative, and managed everything professionally from start to finish.

The food quality and taste were excellent, and all our guests appreciated the arrangements. Parking facility, decoration, lighting, and seating arrangements were also well organized. The management was supportive and ensured that every detail was taken care of on time.

Overall, it is a great venue for weddings, receptions, birthdays, and corporate events. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a well-managed and affordable banquet hall with good service.

Lastly to the Kohinoor Organisation

Don't lose "Mr Nitin Mane" he is a gem for your organisation

featured_reviews.name: Vikas Gorantala
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our daughter's birthday on the ground floor hall, and it was a fantastic experience.  The main seating area comfortably accommodates over 50 guests, and the small stage was a great feature for the cake cutting and some fun performances.
The separate dining area with 15-20 seats was a thoughtful addition, providing a convenient space for guests to enjoy their food without feeling crowded. Both the hall and the dining area were well air-conditioned, which was a huge relief and kept everyone comfortable throughout the event.
A major highlight was the food and service provided by Mayur Caterers. As it's their one of the exclusive venue, we knew we were in good hands, and they did not disappoint. We had a food package that included delicious veg biryani and pav bhaji, which cost around 250 rupees per plate. The staff was incredibly attentive and professional, and they even handled the welcome drinks (Miranda and Thumbs Up) for our guests which we had purchased from D-mart, and they took care of cooling and serving them. Overall, this hall is an ideal choice for anyone looking to host a small-scale function with less than 80 guests otherwise it gets little crowded. I highly recommend it for functions of a similar size.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently booked this Hall in Dadar for a birthday celebration, and I must say, the experience was absolutely fantastic!

The location is very convenient and easy to reach, especially for guests coming from different parts of Mumbai. The hall itself is spacious, well-maintained, and beautifully decorated, creating a warm and festive vibe right from the moment you enter.

The staff was extremely cooperative and professional — they helped with the setup, coordination, and even assisted guests wherever needed. Special thanks to the manager for being responsive and accommodating with last-minute changes.

We opted for their in-house catering, and the food was delicious with a good variety. From kids to adults, everyone enjoyed the spread. The arrangements for music, lighting, and seating were well-executed and up to the mark.

Overall, a perfect venue for birthdays or small family functions. Highly recommended for those looking for a budget-friendly yet premium experience in the Dadar area!

featured_reviews.name: Swetha Somasundaram
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall, Dhadoba Kashinath Thakur Hall is a good venue with a decent capacity of around 500 people, making it suitable for mid-sized gatherings and events.

The presence of a temple on the ground floor adds a spiritual touch, and only vegetarian food is allowed, which is important for traditional functions.

The ambience is pleasant, and the location is convenient.

However, the AC temperature control could be improved, especially during peak summer when the hall gets crowded.

featured_reviews.name: Sushant Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: A good enough for max 250 people. Dining is at ground floor but size can't accommodate in peak time. Interior of hall is beautiful. Located beside gokhale road and 10 mins walking from dadar station.   Sadly can't travel from dadar station to hall by vechile due to heavy rush area of dadar market.

featured_reviews.name: Sachhin Shelar
featured_reviews.review_text: AC hall, Best for 150-200 people. Separate section for food at ground floor. Mayur caterers serving the food, food quality is good.

featured_reviews.name: Nishad Shahasane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a good experience with this hall & their management. At the ground floor there is arrangement for food. On first floor there is grand banquet big enough to fit approx 200 people easily. Service was good, so was food. Great hospitality. The decorations were upto the mark & whole premises were neat & clean.
There is parking issue, but in crowded Dadar that's obvious.

Best for small event like birthday parties. This banquet can also be used for weddings!
Overall good.

featured_reviews.name: V K
featured_reviews.review_text: No parking at all, how guests are gonna come if they don't find parking spot near by? Food seems contain very high percentage of soda since felt full just after having very small portion of plate. 3 stars are just for Hall which is Nice. Spacious enough for around 200 guest ceremony.

featured_reviews.name: Prasanna Valimbe
featured_reviews.review_text: First thing is that this location has two side routes, which is convenient to reach either from route of plaza theatre or from ranade rd. Second thing food had amazing taste, also welcome drinks of kiwi and watermelon juice were awesome in taste. Women in catering area were so helpful to get the food on anybody's request. They were kind and polite. Hall area is also amazing and looks stunning after decoration.
